outcome: accuracy in localizing standard lip and palate planes
cohort: The study included 418 three-dimensional ultrasounds from 288 pregnant women (394 normal, 24 with cleft lip and palate) who were between 11 and 13+6 weeks of pregnancy.
finding: The CLP-Net artificial intelligence model accurately located three standard planes for Cleft Lip and Palate (CLP) screening in both normal and CLP cases, improving localization speed for radiologists.
